column1: # Every persisted derived body, versioned by its compaction code rather than
# the release. Columns: representation name, version, comma-separated source
# files whose text produces the derived bytes (the owning crate's file first),
# and their sha256 (each file as `path\0bytes\0`, in listed order).
# The version lives at the `Derived::new` or `representation` call site; the
# parity test in the owning crate (derive_parity.rs) checks this table. When a
# transform's source changes, the test fails naming the new hash: bump the
# version and update this row in the same commit. `crates/http/src/derive.rs`
# is in every transform's set because it feeds and parses the body.
